name: Sukun Eight
summary: A single eightfold ring gives Islamic geometry a broad, quiet silhouette and an open center.
why: Two concentric eightfold contours share the exact center and rotation. The outer tips are gently rounded, the band stays broad, and the amber quadrant is an exact part of the same ring. No separate ornament is attached to the symbol.
risk: The eightfold form suggests Islamic decorative traditions, but it does not explicitly identify prayer times or a mosque. The app name must provide that context.
sub1: A generous open center held by eight equal points
sub2: An amber quadrant follows the same outline and inner edge

palette.name: SUKUN EIGHT / IVORY + DEEP TEAL + BRASS

reasonToChoose: A simple geometric identity that works as a compact app mark without a literal building or a second symbol.
